o.text: Internationalism. From Russian апре́ль (aprélʹ), ultimately from Latin Aprīlis.

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یوخیسه (yoḫısa). Compare Turkish yoksa (“otherwise”), Turkmen ýogsa (“otherwise, or else”), Turkmen ýogsam (“otherwise”). Equivalent to yox (“no; there is not”) + isə.
From Arabic أَقْرِبَاء (ʔaqribāʔ), plural of قَرِيب (qarīb).
